newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Lauda Air, AUA soar in soft Vienna.
newsitem.headline: Lauda Air, AUA soar in soft Vienna.

text.p: Shares in Austria's leading carriers Austrian Airlines and Lauda Air surged on Thursday as investors welcomed the news that AUA would acquire a 36 percent voting stake in rival Lauda.

At 1200 GMT, Lauda Air was by far the largest gainer in Vienna, standing 14.58 percent higher at 110 schillings, while AUA was 3.55 percent higher at 1,865 schillings in an overall weak Vienna market.
Creditanstalt Investment Bank said the deal represented "a victory for economic good sense."

"Both companies will profit from this strategic cooperation through an improvement in earnings," analyst Renate Sterneder said in a report. This would partly be achieved through the reduction of overcapacities in the former bitter rivals' air traffic. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
